_doc: The town's calendar (calendar.gd, clock.gd): recurring events. A fixed date has month (1..12), date and optionally days (a span); a weekly one has weekly (mon..sun). kind: market, holiday, birthday, league (the calendar screen's colour). toast: the banner's line the morning of the day (clock.gd announces it with the name as its title; none for the weekly market). life.gd, quests.gd or music.gd can ask clock.is_event_day(id). Ash's and Gary's birthdays are a nod to the men they are named after.
